proposed_capability: Preserve a request correlation token before an uncertain game-native submit so a matching current native readback can reconcile without resubmitting.
player_save_control_impact: No new adapter, scene permission, game input, save load or side effects. Preserve existing callback contract and fail closed when readback lacks the reserved token.
expected_outcome: Matching fresh confirmation can reconcile a reserved session attempt even after a lost response. Assisted responses, unrelated references, invented callbacks and duplicate dispatch stay excluded.
negative_tests: No matching reservation token implies no product attribution.
Uncertain attempt is never retried; positive readback must pass the existing native event/effect validators.
rollback_path: Revert only the correlation changes on the isolated successor branch.
unresolved_unknowns: Actual EA submit/event binding and the adapter stamping the reserved token await the Windows game host.
